def processing_batches(items):
    """Bound one inference process, never the user's recording."""
    batch, size = [], 0
    for item in items:
        length = len(item[1]['text'])
        if batch and (size + length > 4000 or len(batch) >= 80):
            yield batch
            batch, size = [], 0
        batch.append(item)
        size += length
    if batch:
        yield batch
